questions.question_text: Solve the equation 3x - 2 = -14.
Solve the equation 7x + 11 = 26 - 3x.
Solve the simultaneous equations. You must show all your working. 5x + 3y = -15, 3x + 5y = -17
Solve the inequality |2x + 1| > 9.
Calculate an estimate of the mean height of the plants.
Complete the cumulative frequency table for the plants.
On the grid, draw the cumulative frequency curve.
Use your cumulative frequency curve to find an estimate for the interquartile range.
The heights, h cm, of 50 different plants are shown in the table, where k is an integer. An estimate of the mean height of these plants is 27cm. Find the value of k.
Translate triangle A with vector (2, -6). Label the image B.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle B onto triangle A.
Rotate triangle A through 90° clockwise about (0, 0). Label the image C.
Reflect triangle A in the line y = x. Label the image D.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle C onto triangle B.
The price of a coat is $84. The price is reduced by 12%. Find the new price of the coat.
The price of a table is reduced by 25%. The price is now $960. Find the original price of the table.
Samir invests $600 in a bank that pays compound interest at a rate of 5.1% each year. Find the value of Samir’s investment after 4 complete years.
Find the number of complete years for the value of Samir’s investment to be first worth more than $1000.
Amir and Bob work together and share their earnings in the ratio 3:5. Find the amount Bob receives when their earnings are $120.

They decide to change the ratio for all further earnings. Amir’s share of the earnings is increased by 20% of his original share. Bob’s share of the earnings is decreased by 20% of his original share. Show that the ratio of their earnings is now 9:10.
Write down the mathematical name of the cyclic quadrilateral ABCD.
Complete the statement. Angle OAP = 90° because ...
Find angle ADC.
Find angle ACD.
Find angle ACB.
Find angle OCA.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x), for values of x between -3 and 3.
The graph cuts the x-axis at points A and B. Work out the length AB.
Solve f(x) = 0.5.
Write down the coordinates of the minimum point of the graph.
The equation f(x) = k has two solutions. Find the range of values of k.
Find the probability that the number on spinner A is 6.
Find the probability that the number on spinner B is not 4.
Find the probability that the number on spinner A is the same as the number on spinner B.
Find the probability that the sum of the two numbers is 6.
On the Venn diagram, shade A ∪ B.
Describe the shaded region using set notation.
The Venn diagram below shows the number of elements in each subset. Find n((A ∩ B) ∩ C').
Show that BC = 9.0 m, correct to 1 decimal place.
Use the sine rule to find angle BCA.
Find the area of triangle ABC.
Find the area of the shaded region.
Find the perimeter of the shape ABDC.
Find the volume of the cone.
Show that the total surface area of the cone is 4000π cm².
A mathematically similar cone has a surface area of 1000π cm². Show that the radius of this cone is 20 cm.
A cone with radius 20 cm is removed from the top of the cone with radius 40 cm to leave a solid. Calculate the surface area of the remaining solid.
y varies inversely as the square root of (x + 1). y = 18 when x = 3. Find the value of y when x = 8.
Find the value of x when y = 1.5.
w varies directly as the square root of (x + 1). w = 18 when x = 3. Find the value of √wy.
Solve f(x) = -7.
Find g⁻¹(x).
Solve g(x) = 7h(f(x)). You must show all your working.
